children: The total stablecoin market capitalization has resumed its upward trend since late July and early August, reaching $304.56 billion, up 0.48% over the past week. According to ChainCatcher, USDC and USD1 were the main drivers of new issuance among leading stablecoins during the week, with USDC increasing 0.76% and USD1 rising 3.71%. USDT's market share is currently 60.21%.

title: Stablecoin Market Cap Rises to $304.56 Billion as USDC and USD1 Lead Weekly Issuance
